product: MERRA-2 · 2 m air temperature (NASA POWER v10, annual mean)
processing: POWER annual mean regridded from 0.5° x 0.625° to 2° using area-weighted averaging; cells with less than 50 percent of their area covered are omitted. anomaly = value - cell mean over the baseline period.
citation: NASA POWER Project: NASA POWER Data v10. NASA Langley Research Center. https://power.larc.nasa.gov/ (CC BY 4.0). Derived from MERRA-2: Gelaro et al. (2017), J. Climate 30, 5419-5454, doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-16-0758.1
